messages.author: 3c30c52b0f668f28
messages.subject: geom_hline and qplot
parts:
Hello,

I don't understand the difference between this two examples :

p <- qplot(x = mtcars$wt, y=mtcars$mpg) # Doesn't work
p
p + geom_hline(yintercept=20)
Erreur dans data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) :
  les arguments impliquent des nombres de lignes différents : 32, 1

q <- qplot(x = wt, y=mpg, data = mtcars)  # Works
q + geom_hline(yintercept=20)

I know that it is better to work with one data.frame instead of two vectors, but I would like to know why the first example doesn't work...

Thank you very much.

David
